# Ida Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** Young child  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c14 P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c9 P77](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0077)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolgirl  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Ida is a slender young girl with dark-blue eyes that resemble those of her late mother. She is described as having a delicate small figure.

_Sources: [v5 c14 P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018), [v5 c34 P12](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0012)_

## Personality

Ida is a tender-hearted, sensitive, and affectionate young girl who is deeply devoted to her father's happiness and the well-being of her family. She is prone to worry and easily frightened by distressing ideas, such as rumors about cruel stepmothers. Despite her fearful nature and self-consciousness regarding her lack of domestic skills, she is capable of great courage and selflessness when acting for the sake of her loved ones.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c9 P83](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0083), [v5 c9 P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)_

## Traits

- Sensitive and easily frightened  <sub>[v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c9 P83](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0083)</sub>
- Devoted and selfless  <sub>[v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031), [v5 c34 P36](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0036)</sub>
- Fear of stepmothers  <sub>[v5 c9 P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 c9 P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 c34 P27](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0027)</sub>

## Abilities

- Soothes her father during distressing times  <sub>[v5 c34 P22](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure her father's happiness by asking Clementine Ainslie to marry him  <sub>[v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)</sub>
- To learn domestic skills like cooking and sewing  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c34 P34](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0034)</sub>

## History

Ida resides at the old manse with her father, Rev. John Knox Ashdown, and her siblings Tobias, Grace, and Rupert. Unlike her siblings, she experiences secret shame over her lack of practical household skills such as cooking and sewing. One Saturday, while exploring Mr. Taylor's pasture barn with her siblings, she nervously accompanied them up to the hayloft, where they discovered the hungry waif Mary Stubbs. Later, Mrs. Hector Twiss attempted to adopt Ida to spite her own family and raise her with wealth and lessons, but her father fiercely rejected the offer out of deep love for Ida and memory of his late wife.

After Mary Stubbs warned her that stepmothers turn fathers against their children, Ida spent a tearful night worrying about the possibility of her father remarrying. However, upon overhearing her father express sorrow over his love life, Ida courageously visited Clementine Ainslie to personally beg her to marry him for his happiness, promising that the children would be well-behaved. Clementine reassured Ida, dispelled her fears about stepmothers, and entrusted her with a note for her father, which Ida happily delivered to his study, successfully bringing about their reconciliation.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c5 P17](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0017), [v5 c9 P78](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0078), [v5 c9 P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 c9 P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 c14 P15](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0015), [v5 c14 P17](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0017), [v5 c14 P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018), [v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 c34 P15](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0015), [v5 c34 P22](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0022), [v5 c34 P24](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0024), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031), [v5 c34 P34](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0034), [v5 c34 P44](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0044)_

- Daughter of Rev. John Knox Ashdown and his late wife Cecelia  <sub>[v5 c9 P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), [v5 c9 P87](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0087), [v5 c14 P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018)</sub>
- Raised at the gray manse alongside her siblings Tobias, Grace, and Rupert  <sub>[v5 c9 P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 c9 P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086)</sub>
